Fill out the application form neatly by typing or in your own handwriting.
Affix your passport size photograph in the designated space on the application form.
Attach self-attested copies of certificates in support of Date of Birth, Educational Qualifications, and Experience.
Pack the application into an envelope.
Superscribe the envelope as "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF PHYSIOTHERAPIST".

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) is conducting this recruitment through its Industrial Health Center in Bangalore.

faq.question: Q2. What post is being recruited?
faq.answer: HAL is recruiting for the Physiotherapist (Part Time / Visit Basis) post.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for forwarding the application is 15 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed SSLC or PUC with a Degree or Diploma in Physiotherapy Course, along with a minimum of 1 year of post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is preferably below 55 years as on 01 October 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the remuneration for the Physiotherapist post?
faq.answer: The remuneration ranges from Rs. 1,300 to Rs. 1,600 per visit depending on the candidate's qualification, for 3 visits in a week.

faq.question: Q8. How should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications must be filled out neatly and sent strictly by post to the Dy. General Manager (HR) at the Industrial Health Center in Bangalore.

faq.question: Q9. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.
